concepts.name: Canonical Definition
concepts.role: Owns admitted term meaning and formation criteria.

concepts.name: Product Ontology
concepts.role: Projects admitted concepts and relationships as a validated graph.

concepts.name: Meta Type
concepts.role: Classifies one kind of domain intent and its obligations.

concepts.name: Realization
concepts.role: Names one admitted architecture for implementing a meta type in a profile.

concepts.name: Implemented Baseline
concepts.role: Freezes exact current definitions, realizations, profiles, and validation bindings.

concepts.name: Meta Type Instance Intent
concepts.role: Supplies the typed project-specific intent to instantiate.

concepts.name: Instantiation Plan
concepts.role: Resolves one exact realization and deterministic write set.

concepts.name: Target Manifest
concepts.role: Binds generated bytes to intent, baseline, realization, and content digests.

concepts.name: Target Implementation
concepts.role: Contains the concrete generated and integrated project bytes.

concepts.name: Conformance Provider
concepts.role: Independently observes one bounded property of locked target bytes.

concepts.name: Semantic Receipt
concepts.role: Records provider truth, residue, identities, and claim ceiling.

concepts.name: Owner Decision
concepts.role: Separately admits, rejects, promotes, or defers an exact evidenced candidate.

concepts.name: Operation Effect Envelope
concepts.role: Declares reads, writes, effects, guards, atomicity, and failure continuation.

concepts.name: Recovery Intent
concepts.role: Records durable work required to restore or compensate a workflow.

concepts.name: Claim
concepts.role: Establishes one worker's current right to execute recovery intent.

concepts.name: Lease
concepts.role: Bounds a claim in time and supports safe takeover after expiry.

concepts.name: Development Evidence Package
concepts.role: Preserves bounded plans, results, receipts, residue, and history without becoming canonical by default.
